criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First line delivers date (June 11), vote (18-9), $1.14T, named command. Second line plants the structural tension. Both fit inside the ~210-char cutoff and stand alone.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: GCI fiber has a direct named-community AK anchor. AI WARN Act hedges correctly but names no AK employer. NDAA AK tie (Eielson, JBER, JPARC, ANC contractors) is analyst inference, flagged as such. Two of three rely on inference for the AK angle; all three name a sector consequence.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Specifics every 1-2 sentences: vote, date, $1.14T, command name, sponsors, threshold (100+), 60 days, six named communities, Cable Innovator, three repair dates, five ANC contractors, two senators.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: NDAA well-sourced (SASC primary + Breaking Defense + DefenseScoop). GCI anchors on KUCB in-window with out-of-window background. AI WARN Act primary (Obernolte) 403'd; rests on Fisher Phillips + FedScoop, attributed correctly. One unresolvable primary caps it at 7.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Close to post_001: analytical, position-taking, compressed structural framing ('host the proving ground' vs 'hold a program node', 'written in conference, not in Alaska'). No influencer hype.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: All paragraphs 2-4 sentences. 449 words (in range). 2925 chars (under cap). No wall of text. NDAA paragraph densest but parseable.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Real debatable either/or tied to the conference-window tension, names a mechanism (political capital, MILCON) and actor (the delegation). No CTA or softener.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Concrete revisit-this trigger: engage Sullivan/Murkowski before floor vote and conference; 12-18 month AI Act runway for HR/legal; GCI reliability signal for edge-compute teams.

one_sentence_fix: Add one sentence to the NDAA paragraph resting on a sourced Alaska-relevant provision or prior NDAA precedent so at least one story's AK tie is not inference, lifting Industry relevance and Source quality off 7.
